messages:
Iris (CS): Hey team — kicking off GreenLeaf pilot (Dedicated, 90d). Need a tight stakeholder list, 3 measurable success signals for procurement, and a 30-day checkpoint plan. Ava, anything urgent to call out?
Ava (GreenLeaf): Hi! Key constraints: EU data only, Okta SSO, and we need audit logs exported to our SIEM. Also procurement wants an early signal for renewal risk by week 6. Weekly syncs preferred.
Ben (Solutions): Noted. I can handle Okta flow + peering form. Ill post the ACL + terraform snippets today.
Rahul (Eng): For perf targets propose: p50 <140ms, p95 <350ms at 4 RPS. We'll enable KV caching for repeated prompts. If p95 misses by 30% we mark as a runway risk.
Pri (CS Programs): I'll own enablement + ROI one-pager. Recommend two workshops: power users and dev integrators. Also will draft a quick NPS-lite for pilot feedback.
Iris (CS): Draft success signals:
- Security & access: Okta SSO + peering validated (Day 10)
- Performance: Baseline captured & within SLOs (Day 12)
- Procurement signal: ROI snapshot + adoption metrics by Day 42
Iris (CS): 30-day checkpoints:
Day 0: Kickoff + access requests
Day 3: Staging endpoint live + smoke tests
Day 7: Okta test users + basic auth verified
Day 12: Perf baseline run + KV cache profiling
Day 18: Enablement session #1 (power users)
Day 25: Integration tests with SIEM log export validated
Day 30: Exec readiness review + feedback sample
deploy-bot: Staging deployment succeeded: greenleaf-staging v1.0 deployed at 2024-06-17T14:03:00Z
Ben (Solutions): Blockers: need GreenLeaf netops to submit peering form and Okta metadata. Ava, can Laura handle that this week?
Ava (GreenLeaf): Laura will send peering details and Okta metadata by EOD tomorrow.
Pri (CS Programs): Action items I own: ROI draft (4d), enablement slides (6d), NPS form (2d).
Rahul (Eng): I'll run Day 12 perf and post results. If p95 > 400ms we iterate infra config.
Iris (CS): Owners recap:
- Okta & peering: Ben
- Perf & infra tuning: Rahul
- Enablement & ROI: Pri
- Customer PM liaison: Ava
- Success lead & go/no-go: Iris
Ava (GreenLeaf): Thanks all — weekly sync on Tuesdays works, 10:00 CET.
Iris (CS): I'll schedule weekly invites and publish kickoff notes + tracker in the onboarding doc: https://redwood.internal/onboard/greenleaf. Closing thread for now, will reopen with updates.
